messages:
Ava: Lunchtime idea — Slinky Grand Prix in the main hallway. One slinky, three runs, best avg time wins. I’ll bring a slinky at 12:25. Winner gets to give a two-word kudos to someone. Who's in? :slinky:
Jon: 100% in. I will absolutely time with dramatic commentary. :stopwatch: :laughing:
Priya: I’ll judge and provide impartial nods. Also bringing a whistle. :whistle:
Marcos: Can we have a people’s choice for best trick? I have an illegal bend technique. :eyes:
Lina: If there are trophies I will provide podium music. Otherwise snacks. :baguette_bread:
OpsBot: hallway-reservations-bot: Hallway A booked 12:25–12:45 for "community event". Please keep fire exits clear.
Sam: Training my slinky with a spreadsheet. Honestly not joking. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
DevBot: posted GIF https://giphy.com/slinky-trick (for inspiration)
Ava: Rules reminder: one slinky per run, no kicking, taps allowed. Judges: Priya + Marcos. Crowd vote via emoji.
Jon: First trial run — I call it "The Quiet Thunder".
Priya: Crowd vote in thread after each run. I’ll start: :tada: for graceful, :eyes: for impressive, :shrug: for chaos.
Marcos: Two-word kudos pre-nominations for the winner: 'Coffee Overlord', 'Calm Chaos', 'Late-Night-Donor' (ok that last one is three words).
Lina: I nominate 'Snack Santa' for whoever brings pastries next week.
Sam: 'Spreadsheet Whisperer' — for Ava if the slinky survives her handling.
Jon: Post-race two-word shoutouts: here goes — 'Silent Thunder' for Priya.
Priya: 'Graceful Chaos' for Marcos. Well played. :trophy:
Ava: Love these. Whoever wins, own your two-word blessing. Meeting the slinky at the lobby in 3. See you there! :slinky: :coffee:
